source_snapshot.procedure: Install nvqual, run Input EDPp and check GPU power sensor.

source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes nvqual edpp with full log and elevated-load approval.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require immutable artifact, signed EDPp envelope and independent power-path/thermal protection evidence.

old_problem: The proprietary Input EDPp run had no immutable NVQual/wrapper identity, approved stimulus envelope, signed voltage/current/input-power limits, power-path capacity, independent protection oracle or recovery, so harness PASS alone could not establish electrical qualification.
disposition_reason: The source clearly defines a full Input EDPp qualification and GPU power-sensor check. ED-03 permits the exact artifact, envelope and limits to be bound as project configuration; ED-15 prohibits PASS until signed numeric limits exist, while ED-14 preserves the full 20-minute allocation and every subtest.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row376 all 18 XLSX columns, its same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2969 and unique variant.
Separated the vendor harness result from independent voltage, current, input-power, VRM, PSU/feed, thermal and error evidence.
Retained every Input EDPp subtest, the source 20-minute machine allocation, GPU power-sensor check and cooldown/final-health coverage.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row377 and verified its manifest identity; no DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: NVQual Input EDPp signed electrical-envelope qualification
test_case.purpose: Exercise every approved Input EDPp subtest for the full source duration and prove the requested GPU input-power envelope is achieved without violating signed electrical, PSU/VRM, cooling, protection or platform-health limits.
required_package: Licensed NVQual version/provenance/checksum and compatible GPU/driver stack
Pinned Input EDPp wrapper/hash and complete subtest manifest
Approved stimulus axes, target envelope, tolerance, sampling rate and 20-minute duration
Signed voltage/current/input-power/VRM/PSU/feed and thermal limits with sensor provenance
Workload drain, redundant-power/cooling capacity, OOB hard stops, cooldown and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After artifact, envelope, power-path, isolation and safety approval, preserve baseline logs and synchronized electrical/thermal/health telemetry; run the pinned complete Input EDPp suite once for the source 20-minute allocation, retain every subtest and sample, stop on any approved hard limit, then cool down and verify restored platform health.
test_case.expected_result: Every required Input EDPp subtest completes successfully; requested envelope points and tolerances are met; independently measured voltage, current, input power, VRM, PSU/feed and thermal values remain within signed limits; no protection trip, XID, AER, BMC or platform-health anomaly occurs; cooldown returns the system to its approved baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete subtest output plus time-aligned, sensor-attributed measurements against signed numeric envelope and protection limits and verified recovery. Harness PASS, plausible readings or absent thresholds cannot pass; any limit excursion or protection/health event is reported for engineer verdict.
safety_gate: Explicit power/thermal owner approval, workload drain and independent OOB access
Verify PSU/feed redundancy and headroom, cooling capacity, sensor provenance and all hard stops before load
Preserve existing logs; do not clear evidence to form a baseline
Abort once on electrical, thermal, protection, XID, AER or reachability anomaly; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: NVQual provenance/version/checksum, stack compatibility, wrapper hash and subtest manifest
Approved envelope axes/targets/tolerance/duration and signed sensor/limit matrix
Complete NVQual output, exits and every subtest result
Protection/XID/AER/BMC events, stop reason if any, cooldown and final restored-health record
test_case.recovery: On any trip, excursion or lost reachability, stop load without retry, preserve all telemetry and event evidence, use independent OOB to determine state, allow controlled cooldown, isolate the affected rail/GPU/power path and restore only through the approved platform recovery plan.

blocked.reason: Purpose, workload boundary, evidence and safe recovery are defined; the exact licensed artifact, envelope and signed limits remain mandatory execution prerequisites.
